'''Ursosaurs''' were a territorial [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==Description==
Thick-scaled reptiles, the ursosaur was a massive beast native to the planet Auratera. Ranging in color from brown to green, ursosaurs were quadrupeds with dark beaks and strong claws.<ref name="NoP" />
